in_marathi.name: Ekamansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekamansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekamansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Eka' meaning one and 'Mansh' meaning god. This name signifies the belief in one supreme deity. It is a name that embodies unity and devotion to the divine.
